members.name: banking_routing
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific customer issue is the message about?

criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account; accounts for children/teens
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay (setup, availability, top-ups via Apple Pay/Google Pay not working, what they accept)
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where the card can be used for cash
criteria.auto_top_up: Automatic top-up: how it works, setting it up, its limits
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: A bank transfer into the account has not shown up in the balance yet; money seems missing from the balance
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown up in the balance yet
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Can't add a payee / beneficiary, or transfer to them was not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made (including one sent to the wrong account)
criteria.card_expiring: Card about to expire, renewal, what happens when it expires
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, whether merchants/places take it
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options/tracking, sending a card to another country
criteria.card_linking: Linking/adding a card to the app; reactivating a card the customer thought was lost but found again
criteria.card_payment_fee: Unexpected fee charged on a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: An unknown charge or card payment the customer does not recognise or did not make (e.g. 'I need to cancel a transaction on my debit card')
criteria.card_payment_wrong_fx: Wrong or bad exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept/swallowed the card, or customer lost access to their card after using an ATM
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears in the app that the customer did not make, or cash shown in the app that they never received ('non-received cash')
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN (routine, no suspicion of compromise)
criteria.compromised_card: Card details or PIN may have been stolen or compromised; someone else may know them or be using the card
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank/service is available in or whether it works all over the world; signing up for the service while living in another country
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or denied (even if the customer also mentions their card)
criteria.unexplained_incoming_money: Unexpected money appeared in the account that the customer did not put there (not questions about proving where their own funds come from)
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer disputes: unknown/unauthorised, or wants their money back from a direct debit
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, how many cards)
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change name, address, phone or other personal details
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rates are used / how they are set
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra fee or small odd charge (e.g. £1) on the statement that the customer questions or says was charged in error, even if they bought nothing of that amount
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies are supported for holding or exchanging (not about receiving incoming payments)
criteria.get_disposable_card: How to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting the physical card, finding the PIN for a new card
criteria.lost_stolen_card: Card is currently lost or stolen (not found again)
criteria.lost_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left somewhere; whether they can still use the app without their phone
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, replacement card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / can't log in
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment (card purchase) is still pending or taking long to go through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal the customer made is still pending, or their balance still shows money they already took out in cash
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending, or the customer has no receipt/confirmation for a money transfer they made
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many attempts
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or salary into the account, including receiving it in a foreign currency (not unexplained money the customer did not expect)
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, or wants to cancel an order/purchase or a charge for goods/services (e.g. not received); how refunds work
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, cancelled, terminated or came back to the account (even if the customer thinks the card is not working), or the customer cannot find a payment they made
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which external cards (e.g. American Express, credit cards) can be used to top up or put funds into the account, and which currencies are supported (not Visa-vs-Mastercard questions)
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer_fee: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_card_fee: Fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up (add money) using a card: the steps and where to find the option
criteria.charged_twice: Same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.transfer_fee: Fee charged on a transfer, including the recipient receiving less than the amount sent
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds checks: proving or finding out where the customer's funds come from, who is giving them their money
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code / check for a card top-up
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa vs Mastercard questions: whether the bank's card is Visa or Mastercard, whether they can get or use a Visa or Mastercard; which card the customer can choose
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash than requested, or the customer could not get the full cash amount they asked for
criteria.wrong_fx_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad

instructions.guidance: Choose by what the customer actually needs, not by individual words they use. Each option names the team that handles it.
